'''''Trifolium scabrum''''', the '''rough clover''', is a species of annual herb in the family [[Fabaceae]]. They have a self-supporting growth form and compound, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to {{Convert|0.12|m|frac=4}}.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Trifolium scabrum L. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/703440|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Trifolium scabrum (Rough Clover): MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/FABC/Trifolium_scabrum.php |access-date=2022-03-07 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us}}</ref>
